# Vendored DCNv4 operator

This directory contains `DCNv4_op` from the official
[OpenGVLab/DCNv4](https://github.com/OpenGVLab/DCNv4) repository.

- Upstream commit: `4b848f7dd7da74ff03f7d278f902c6fd05b391b5`
- Local source directory: upstream `DCNv4_op/`
- License: see `LICENSE`

The source is vendored so Linux training environments can build a reproducible CUDA
extension without fetching an unpinned upstream branch.
